name: Agent
description: The Agent of Mystery - Earth searched the Fairy needed for the next play. The Agent of Creation - Venus could put multiple Mystical Shine Balls on the field, while Master Hyperion converted Fairies in the Graveyard into removal.

defining_cards.name: Master Hyperion
defining_cards.why: The Agent engine helped summon this boss and supplied LIGHT Fairies for its card-destruction effect.

defining_cards.name: The Agent of Creation - Venus
defining_cards.why: Paying 500 life points per Mystical Shine Ball filled the field with material for Synchro or Rank 2 Xyz plays.

defining_cards.name: The Agent of Mystery - Earth
defining_cards.why: Its Normal Summon found another Agent while leaving a Level 2 Tuner on the field.

defining_cards.name: Archlord Kristya
defining_cards.why: With four Fairies in the Graveyard, it could land beside the Agent engine and lock both players out of Special Summons.

defining_cards.name: Gachi Gachi Gantetsu
defining_cards.why: Venus could summon two Mystical Shine Balls to make this durable Rank 2 and boost the team's stats.
